title: after a little work.. it extended
text: after a little work.. it extended. After considerable struggling with a jammed tension piece, working with their customer service, a hammer and a pair of pliers, I prevailed and got the rod to extend.  I am hoping this was a one in a million occurrence and won't be an issue for other consumers.  I always update with useful info if it arises.
